AUTHOR: Wang
TITLE: DyFish-DETR: Underwater Fish Image Recognition Based on Detection Transformer
VENUE: JOURNAL OF MARINE SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
REGION: Zhujiang Park, Guangzhou, China (+ Taiwan F4K, Denmark Brackish, RUOD)
DATA: Own freshwater fish dataset (park water, submerged RGB cameras); also Fish4Knowledge23, Brackish, RUOD
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The created freshwater fish dataset contains multiple angles and parts of fish photographed under different brightness levels'
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'selecting 4691 images for our dataset. Following a ratio of 7:1:2, we divided the images into training sets, validation sets, and testing sets.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'we applied DyFish-DETR to three public underwater datasets separately' - each dataset evaluated on its own split; no cross-dataset test.
E_EV: Table 2: 'The results of DyFish-DETR in the freshwater fish dataset' - P, R, mAP50, mAP50:95 only.
ARCH: DyFish-DETR (RT-DETR based; DyFishNet backbone with dynamic snake convolution, Slim Hybrid Encoder)
METR: P, R, mAP50, mAP50:95, COCO AP/AR, FPS, FLOPs
NOTE: INCL: own images from cameras submerged in park water (Zhujiang Park; koi and tilapia - semi-natural urban pond/lake, not aquaculture); also Brackish (monitoring dataset). Verifier: park pond may be judged non-natural. V3=Y from qualitative 'different brightness levels' only. Split unit stated as images with ratio; randomness not explicitly stated. Platform (fixed vs handheld) not stated. RUOD and F4K23 are benchmark sets.
AUTHORS_FULL: Wang, ZW; Ruan, ZK; Chen, C
